sentiment: Summer ends quietly; the machines hum their computations while birds pass unnoticed — we learn to see what we almost missed.
scene: A bird lands on the corner of a softly humming server rack at dusk, its dark eye catching the blink of a status light, the last amber light of August slanting through a window.

stories.title: I turned my security cameras into an automatic bird identification system
stories.reason: Machines learning to notice the small lives passing through — the hum of computation pointed at something gentle.
stories.summary: Security cameras retrained as birdwatchers — a surveillance system turned toward recognition and care, proof that attention can be repurposed.

stories.title: Fastpotify
stories.reason: Speed for its own sake, all friction filed away — the machine hum at its most efficient.
stories.summary: A faster Spotify client — the quiet obsession of making the machinery between you and the music disappear.

stories.title: GPU World
stories.reason: The vast geography of computation — a whole world humming under the one you walk through.
stories.summary: A catalog of the GPU universe — the hidden continent of silicon that computes behind every ordinary day.
